rootComponent.name: Regensburg_DigitalerEnergieZwilling_digital-energy-twin_addon
rootComponent.description: Civitas Core addon that deploys and integrates the Regensburg digital energy twin application.

imageComponents.notes: Admin frontend image deployed by the addon; its verified, digest-bound SBOM is maintained as a modular child BOM.
Public frontend image deployed by the addon; its verified, digest-bound SBOM is maintained as a modular child BOM.
Backend image used for database migration and application runtime; its verified, digest-bound SBOM is maintained as a modular child BOM.

additionalComponents.name: Civitas Core
additionalComponents.notes: The addon consumes Civitas Core inventory, shared access tasks, and platform services; the host version is selected by the deployment.

additionalComponents.name: ansible-core
additionalComponents.notes: Executes the addon playbook; the version is supplied by the Civitas Core control environment.

additionalComponents.name: kubernetes.core
additionalComponents.notes: Provides the k8s and k8s_info modules used throughout the addon; the version is supplied by the Civitas Core control environment.

additionalComponents.name: jmespath
additionalComponents.notes: Required by the Ansible json_query filter used to select Keycloak clients; the version is supplied by the control environment.

additionalComponents.name: Kubernetes
additionalComponents.notes: Runs the Deployments, Services, Secrets, ConfigMaps, and Ingress resources created by the addon; the cluster version is deployment-specific.

additionalComponents.name: Traefik
additionalComponents.notes: The platform ingress controller routes the three addon hosts directly to the APISIX gateway service using standard Ingress resources in the APISIX namespace; the controller version is supplied by the platform.

additionalComponents.name: cert-manager
additionalComponents.notes: Issues certificates for the three TLS Ingress resources through the configured cluster issuer; the version is supplied by the platform.

additionalComponents.name: Apache APISIX
additionalComponents.relationship: required application gateway and policy integration
additionalComponents.notes: Routes frontend and backend traffic and enforces OIDC, role, CORS, rate-limit, and response-header policies; the version is supplied by Civitas Core.

additionalComponents.name: Keycloak
additionalComponents.relationship: required identity and access management integration
additionalComponents.notes: Provides the OIDC client, roles, client secret, discovery metadata, and token introspection used by the application; the version is supplied by Civitas Core.

additionalComponents.name: PostgreSQL
additionalComponents.notes: Stores backend application data in a database provisioned on central-db or another existing Zalando cluster, or in a separately managed existing database; the server version is deployment-specific.

additionalComponents.name: Zalando Postgres Operator
additionalComponents.notes: Reconciles the acid.zalan.do/v1 postgresql resource used to provision the addon database on central-db or another existing Zalando cluster; not used in existing-database mode.
